faq.title: Answers before you join.

items.a: Four corridors at launch: Lagos ⇄ Kano, Lagos ⇄ Abuja, Lagos ⇄ Onitsha/Aba, and Port Harcourt ⇄ Aba ⇄ Onitsha ⇄ Enugu.
Not yet. Every booking is a full truckload: one sender, one truck.
Before the truck is sent, by bank transfer to an account number made for your trip. We hold the money and release it in stages as the trip happens.
You see one all-in price for your load before you pay, with nothing added later. There are no subscriptions or sign-up fees.
Your payment is held from the moment you pay and released in stages as the trip happens. The final payment is released only after your receiver confirms delivery.

items.q: How do you check truck owners?
items.a: Before their first load we check the owner's identity, the truck and its papers, and the bank account we pay into.
Part of the pay is released when the goods are loaded, and the balance after the receiver confirms delivery with a code. Payouts go to the owner's verified bank account.

items.q: What happens if something goes wrong on the way?
items.a: Your payment stays protected. If there's a problem with the goods, only the amount in question is held while our team works it out with both sides.
Soon. Join the waitlist and we'll contact you before your route opens.
No. The waitlist is free and you can ask to be removed at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This notice explains what Freight Africa collects when you join our waitlist, why, and what you can ask us to do with it. It follows the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

sections.title: What we collect
body: Your name, WhatsApp number, and email address if you give one.
Whether you send goods, own trucks or work as an agent, the routes you're interested in, and for truck owners, how many trucks you have.
Where you heard about us, if the link you used tells us, and the time you joined.
To stop abuse, we keep a scrambled version of your internet address for one day. We can't turn it back into the address.

sections.title: Why we collect it
body: To contact you before your route opens, and to plan which routes and trucks we need first. We don't sell your details or use them for anything else.

sections.title: Who handles it for us
body: Supabase stores the waitlist on servers in Ireland. Resend sends our emails. Vercel runs this website. Each handles your details only to provide that service to us.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Until we launch on your route and for 12 months after, or until you ask us to remove it, whichever comes first.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for a copy of your details, ask us to correct them, or ask us to delete them. Email us and we'll reply within 30 days.
If you're unhappy with how we handle your details, you can complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission.

sections.title: Contact
body: Email {contact} about anything in this notice.

terms.title: Waitlist terms
terms.intro: These terms cover joining the Freight Africa waitlist before we launch. Full terms of service will apply when you start booking or carrying loads.

sections.title: Joining is free
body: The waitlist costs nothing and doesn't commit you to anything.

sections.title: No booking yet
body: Joining doesn't book a truck, reserve a load or fix a price. Routes on this website describe our plans for launch and may change before then.

sections.title: Nothing here is an offer
body: Information on this website describes how we plan to work at launch. It isn't an offer, a quote or a commitment to a price, charge, payout time or service level. The Terms of Service that apply when you book or accept a load will govern.

sections.title: Correct details
body: Please give your own name and a number you use. We may remove entries that look false.

sections.title: Leaving the list
body: Email {contact} at any time and we'll remove your details.

sections.title: Your details
body: Our {privacy} explains what we collect and why.

faq.q: What happens if no truck accepts?
faq.a: We keep looking. After 24 hours you can raise your price, change the day, or get a full refund. Your money stays held the whole time.

faq.q: How does offering my own price work?
faq.a: You pay the price you offer, and we hold it safely. Verified owners on your route see it. They can accept it, or reply with their own price. If they reply, you choose to pay the difference, offer again once, or decline. If nobody agrees within 24 hours, you can raise your offer, change the day, or get every naira back.

faq.q: When is my money released to the owner?
faq.a: Part goes to the owner when your goods are loaded, and the rest when the receiver confirms delivery with the code.
The receiver gets it before the truck arrives and gives it to the driver once the goods are delivered. The driver never sees it before.

faq.q: Can I see where my goods are?
faq.a: Yes. Open the trip and tap Track. You see the truck on the map while it is on the road, and each step as it happens.

faq.q: Something arrived damaged or short. What do I do?
faq.a: Use Report a problem on the trip. We hold the owner's balance while we look into it.

faq.q: How do I add someone from my team?
faq.a: Go to Team and tap Invite. They get an email to join your business.

noAccess.text: {page} is for {roles}. Ask a super admin if you need it.

staffTrips.lead: Every trip, its full story, and what you can do about it
staffTrips.noneText: Trips show here as soon as a truck is confirmed.
staffTrips.notePlaceholder: What happened, who you spoke to
staffTrips.codesText: Loading and delivery codes go to the pickup contact and the receiver. Staff never see them.

effects.loaded: The goods count as loaded and the owner's advance is paid from the money held.
effects.delivered: The trip counts as delivered; the balance is released after the waiting time unless the sender reports a problem.
effects.release: The owner's balance is paid now from the money held.

staffTrips.reasonHint: At least 5 characters: what you checked and with whom.
staffTrips.done: Done. It's in the audit log.
staffTrips.failed: That didn't go through. The trip may have moved on: reload and check.
staffTrips.wait: The balance waits for the sender's problem window to end. It's released then by itself.

inviteEmail.subject: You're invited to the Freight Africa staff console
inviteEmail.body: You've been invited to join the Freight Africa staff console. Open the link to set up your PIN and two-step sign-in.

staffAdmin.failed: That didn't go through. Reload and try again.
staffAdmin.done: Done. It's in the audit log.

approvals.lead: Changes that need a second person. Nobody can approve their own request.
approvals.money: Payouts and refunds over the limit
approvals.none: Nothing waiting for a second person.
approvals.yours: Your request: another super admin decides it
approvals.approveEffect: The setting changes now, for every new load.
approvals.rejectEffect: The setting stays as it is.
approvals.moneyEffect: It's paid out from the money held.

settings.lead: How the platform runs. Money settings need a second super admin.
settings.valueHint: Keep the same shape (number, true or false, text, or the same keys).
settings.waiting: Sent for a second super admin to approve.
settings.badValue: That value doesn't fit this setting.

fees.lead: Service fees, commission and offer limits. Shown only here, never on the public site (D031). Changes need a second super admin.

audit.lead: Every change to money, status, access and settings. It can't be edited.

team.lead: Staff accounts, roles and invites. Two-step sign-in is required for everyone.
team.name: Name
team.sent: Invite sent. The link works for 48 hours.
team.notSent: The invite was made but the email didn't send. Invite them again to send a new link.

messages.lead: What we send by email, SMS, push and in the app. WhatsApp is off until it's connected.
messages.whatsappNote: WhatsApp templates stay on hold until WhatsApp is connected; then they join with the 24-hour reply window.

staffAdmin.fresh: Enter your authenticator code again, then try once more.

recon.lead: Every morning at 06:00 the ledger is checked: money held for finished loads must be zero, and every payment out must be posted. The Bachs report joins this when the Bachs account is live.
recon.resolveEffect: It's marked resolved with your note, in the audit log.

kinds.escrow_not_zero: Money still held for a finished load
kinds.provider_difference: Bachs report differs from the ledger

loads.lead: Every load from booking to a confirmed truck. Loads paid but without a truck come first.

users.lead: Truck businesses and senders. Open one to see its people, trucks and papers.

catalogue.lead: The goods and trucks people can choose when they book or add a truck.

corridors.lead: The four corridors and the lane prices behind every quote.

push.title: Notifications on this phone
push.on: On: trip changes and replies arrive even when the app is closed.
push.off: Off: you'll still see everything in the app.
push.blocked: Blocked in your browser settings. Allow notifications for Freight Africa there.

receipt.title: Receipt
receipt.paidDemo: Paid through the demo checkout (no real money)
